key_insight: MICViT improves 3D brain MRI learning by separately modeling modality-specific and cross-modal relationships at both local and global scales.
clinical_relevance: This could help create more accurate MRI-based biomarkers, such as brain age estimates, by better using complementary information from multiple scan types.
method: Four attention paths: intra-modal local, intra-modal global, cross-modal local, cross-modal global
Evaluated on brain age prediction across heterogeneous datasets and MRI modalities
evidence_signal: The model was tested on UK Biobank (n=41,404), SOOP (n=1,062), and Cam-CAN (n=613) and consistently outperformed CNN and transformer baselines in 3D settings.
watch_item: Performance gains may depend on having multiple co-registered MRI modalities and careful handling of limited sample sizes and dataset differences.
paper_title: Modeling Local, Global, and Cross-Modal Context in Multimodal 3D MRI
